item.title: Apparent fraud and theft discovered at Cochrane area operation : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: Theft and fraud at what OPP only refer to as “a large industrial operation located northeast of Cochrane” is estimated to be worth $500,000.

item.title: Kap Legion hosting open house Saturday : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: The Royal Canadian Legion Branch 85 in Kapuskasing is marking its 100th anniversary this year with a special open house on Saturday from 10 am to 3 pm.

item.title: Program looking for volunteers to talk about their careers : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: The Timmins Chamber of Commerce, in conjunction with the provincial education ministry, is offering career coaching events at high schools from Hearst to Temiskaming Shores and needs volunteer coaches.

item.title: Former bowling alley roof collapses in Kapuskasing : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: Residents are being asked to avoid an area in downtown Kapuskasing where the roof of a former bowling alley collapsed this morning.

item.title: Two pilots dead after Air Canada Express jet collides with firefighting vehicle at LaGuardia : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: Two pilots are dead and at least 41 others were taken to hospital after an Air Canada Express flight collided with a Port Authority aircraft rescue and firefighting vehicle while landing at New York’s LaGuardia Airport late Sunday, officials said Monday.

item.title: Marking World Tuberculosis Day : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: Today (Tues.) is World Tuberculosis Day, and Northeastern Public Health is joining the global movement to make people aware of it and work towards getting rid of it.

item.title: Former bowling alley demolished after roof collapse in Kap : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: Demolition is underway on the former bowling alley after the roof collapsed yesterday morning in Kapuskasing.

item.title: Progress report on veterinary services for Kap expected at meeting next month : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: Progress that a veterinary recruitment committee is making to bring a vet to Kapuskasing will be discussed during an important meeting on Tuesday, April 14th at 6 pm at the Civic Centre.

item.title: District hospital names new CEO : My Kap-Hearst Now
item.description: There’s a new president and CEO moving into the office at the Timmins and District Hospital on June 1st.
